_note: Specification-level flow definition, not a pac-exported artifact — no tenant to build this in yet (docs/09-build-report.md).
description: Nudges a technician who hasn't returned something by its expected-return date, and gives the office admin a weekly summary.

actions.name: Find_overdue_checkouts
actions.detail: eng_transaction where eng_transactiontype = Checkout AND eng_expectedreturn < today, joined to its lines where the asset's eng_status is still CheckedOut (i.e. not yet returned).
actions.note: ASSUMPTION: Q8 (open) — expected return is currently optional on checkout (specs/clarifications.md recommendation), so this query only ever covers checkouts where the technician supplied a date. Every skipped checkout is invisible to this flow by construction, not a bug in it. See app/src/features/checkout/CheckoutPage.tsx's 'Expected return (optional)' field and its own note.

actions.name: DM_custodian
actions.detail: One message per overdue asset (or grouped per custodian), deep-linking to the Return screen.

actions.name: Weekly_summary_to_admin
actions.detail: Once a week, an office admin gets everything overdue at their office. Snooze-via-reply is explicitly out of scope for Phase 1 (docs/03-automation.md).
